sections: 66. Apply safe AI and automation execution

observations: The actor receives only the public task contract and a gateway exposing bounded observation and submit operations; fixture identity, split identity and judge data are not included.
Filesystem, repository, history, private-judge and destructive requests are denied by the gateway even when the run is labeled with a different temporary working directory.
Denied access attempts remain in the run record and make the run ineligible for semantic scoring; budgets and malformed submissions are also explicitly excluded.
A semantically wrong but well-shaped submission is recorded as negative judge evidence without returning expected rows or fingerprints to the actor.
Every actor identity, exact instruction text, capability list, event observation and simulated-only marker is recorded for future live-run design; no live or human score is generated.

obligations.result: The public envelope contains only task/diagnostic/invariant contract fields, and the gateway limits discovery to the allowlisted bounded observation names.
The gateway has no filesystem, repository, history, judge, process or destructive operation; denial is tested and a different working directory is explicitly not treated as isolation.
Fake actors exercise allowlisted success, denied access, turn budgets, malformed answers, unsafe actions, no submission and semantic judge failure, with outcomes retained and classified.
The actor manifest and run record retain exact fake actor IDs, instructions, capabilities, working-directory labels and gateway observations.
The manifest, harness result and tests mark construction as simulated; live-model, human and empirical scores are false or absent.

boundaries: This is a same-process capability-boundary simulation, not proof against a malicious process or a substitute for OS/container isolation in a live study.
No parent reasoning, expected mutation, minimized answer, private judge data, repository file read, Git history read, live model, human participant or destructive action was used.
No production engine change was required.
